title: Many Weapons
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about one key that throws different things. A pouch of stars and a pouch of flames fill counters, and Enter throws a flame if there is one, a star if there is not, and shrugs when there is neither. A star pops a mint green gumdrop but cannot melt a frosty grump; a flame can. Each weapon is a sequence in the character file, and the levels are built so that you feel the difference. Nothing here hurts. Signs explain each idea, and every level has a page on how it is made.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie has two short levels to cross and a pocketful of pouches to find. A pouch of stars, a pouch of flames, a mint green gumdrop and a frosty grump in a narrow way. Enter is the only throwing key, and what it throws depends on what you are carrying. Signs say what each level shows, and the manual says how each is made.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
One key throws a flame, a star or nothing: each weapon is a sequence that counts its own uses
Made to be copied and taken apart
